shared_elements: frontal/profile human head with stylised headdress or hair
stylised hands/arms rendered on the torso
carved relief on a flat stone surface
repeated circular/disc motifs (rosettes in A, concentric circles in B)
justification: Both depict the human form and both include disc-like circular motifs (a rosette frieze in A, concentric rings on the back of the figure in B), but these are generic correspondences. A shows a procession of naturalistically proportioned figures in strict profile, walking in file, carrying bowls and holding hands, arranged in a horizontal register beneath a border of rosettes; B is a single massive frontal/blocky figure whose body surface carries schematic incised motifs with no narrative scene, no register system and no interaction between figures.
